description: Receive mail on a verified domain or a subdomain of it. Requires a paid plan or admin receiving grant; disabled or held workspaces get 403 FORBIDDEN. Returns the MX record to publish; present it to the user. Prefer a subdomain such as "in": the domain itself usually already receives mail through the user’s mailbox provider, and a second MX would split it. Receiving MX records are checked every five minutes; the workspace owner is emailed on discovery, confirmed loss and restoration.

subdomain.description: Labels below the domain, e.g. "in" for in.acme.com. Omit for the domain itself. Never "send" as the first label: send.<domain> is the Return-Path host and is refused.

name: enable_domain_inbound

mxPublished.description: Whether the MX record resolves to eusend now.

title: Receive email on a domain
